args.CommandLine:
"bash -c '
echo "=== NETWORK INTERFACES & HARDWARE ==="
lspci -nnk | grep -iA 3 -E "net|wireless|network"
echo "--- USB Network Devices ---"
lsusb | grep -iE "net|wireless|802\.11|wifi" || true

echo -e "\n=== WIRELESS INTERFACE & DRIVER ==="
iw dev 2>/dev/null || ip link show

echo -e "\n=== WI-FI POWER MANAGEMENT STATUS ==="
for w in $(iw dev 2>/dev/null | awk "/Interface/ {print \$2}"); do
    echo "Interface: $w"
    iw dev "$w" get power_save 2>/dev/null || echo "Could not query power_save with iw"
done

echo -e "\n=== NETWORKMANAGER POWER SAVE CONFIG ==="
grep -rn "powersave" /etc/NetworkManager/ 2>/dev/null || echo "No explicit powersave configs found in /etc/NetworkManager/"

echo -e "\n=== CURRENT WI-FI CONNECTION STATUS & SIGNAL ==="
nmcli -f ACTIVE,SSID,BSSID,MODE,CHAN,FREQ,RATE,SIGNAL,BARS,SECURITY dev wifi 2>/dev/null || iwconfig 2>/dev/null || true

echo -e "\n=== ACTIVE CONNECTION DETAILS ==="
nmcli connection show --active 2>/dev/null || true
'"

args.CommandLine:
"bash -c '
echo "=== KERNEL & RTW89 LOGS ==="
dmesg -T | grep -iE "rtw89|wlan0|deauth|beacon|firmware|pci.*b852" | tail -n 40 || true

echo -e "\n=== NETWORKMANAGER DISCONNECT LOGS ==="
journalctl -u NetworkManager -b 0 --no-pager | grep -iE "disconnect|deauthenticat|link timed out|failed to|reason" | tail -n 30 || true

echo -e "\n=== ROUTING & GATEWAY ==="
ip route show

echo -e "\n=== PING TESTS (ROUTER & INTERNET) ==="
GATEWAY=$(ip route | awk "/default.*wlan0/ {print \$3; exit}")
echo "Default Gateway: $GATEWAY"
if [ -n "$GATEWAY" ]; then
    echo "Pinging gateway ($GATEWAY)..."
    ping -c 4 -W 2 "$GATEWAY" || echo "Gateway ping failed!"
fi

echo -e "\nPinging 1.1.1.1..."
ping -c 4 -W 2 1.1.1.1 || echo "1.1.1.1 ping failed!"

echo -e "\nPinging google.com (DNS check)..."
ping -c 4 -W 2 google.com || echo "DNS / google.com ping failed!"

echo -e "\n=== WIREGUARD VPN STATUS ==="
ip -details link show tiktok 2>/dev/null || true

echo -e "\n=== RTW89 MODULE PARAMETERS ==="
modinfo rtw89_pci 2>/dev/null | grep -i parm || true
modinfo rtw89_core 2>/dev/null | grep -i parm || true
systool -v -m rtw89_pci 2>/dev/null || ls /sys/module/rtw89_pci/parameters/ 2>/dev/null || true
'"
